description: Tempête Ciaran - fermeture des jardins is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Brest métropole. Management of the closure/opening of parks/wood/gardens following storm Ciaran Thematic Events Producer Brest metropolis Creator Green spaces Detailed sheet INSPIRE Id EVENATJardCiaran Type Ladder 0 Territory Brest metropolis. Coverage: Brest métropole. The portal shows the English title as "Storm Ciaran - closing of gardens" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Brest métropole. Its keywords include evenements, parcs, jardins, tempete, arbres, ciaran. The listing shows 2 download or service links in SHP, ARCGIS. The listing shows 2026-07-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
